text_to_speech: Life and Death of a Planetary System Chapter 6: Aging into Gianthood 10 billion to 11 billion years Stars like our Sun become red giants when they are old. A red giant's core gets smaller but also very hot... making the star puff up so much that it can eat the closest planets to it.
